coverage: Two literature landmarks in the 9 arcmin² NIRSpec field within the 58 arcmin² GOODS-S/JADES imaging context; not an all-sky or complete high-redshift galaxy sample.
limitations: Angular positions and spectroscopic redshifts are catalog observations; all displayed cosmological distances and ages are model-derived.
These two landmarks must not be replicated, randomized, or used to fill unobserved directions.
The catalog does not represent every known high-redshift galaxy and makes no current-record-holder claim.
